comparison.scalePolicy: fixed first-frame clip anchor, never normalize each frame independently
comparison.note: Single-reference pilot, one original walk generation per service plus one Ludo Fix Loop repair. Structural QA does not establish walking quality. No production approval.

voidless.inputTransform: Service requested contain/pad to 1024x1024 from 1254x1254; no Remove BG applied
voidless.prompt: Right-facing side-view walk cycle, in place, seamless loop. Natural alternating steps, planted feet, bent knees and weight shift. Preserve red feathered hat, ivory feather, red cape, face and outfit. Hold one sword. Whole body and sword inside a fixed canvas. No dust, glow or camera motion.
voidless.multipleAnimatorCostObserved: 100 credits for one-pass, 200 credits platformer set; not submitted
voidless.motionVerdict: failed-walk: all 16 frames hold nearly the same leg pose; lower-body IoU to first >= 0.990; user feedback confirms no walk
voidless.endFrameCondition: Existing default end frame was the base image; left selected for seamless loop. Other end-frame conditions not tested.

ludo.supplementalWorkflow: Sprite Generator Animate, Hydra, max duration 3s, Max Frames 36, size Max, loop on, Auto margin; 9 credits; same reference and submitted walk prompt as Voidless

hydra.motionVerdict: Alternating steps visible; candidate for further review. User reports abrupt loop seam. Watermarked export.
hydra.prompt: Right-facing side-view walk cycle, in place, seamless loop. Natural alternating steps, planted feet, bent knees and weight shift. Preserve red feathered hat, ivory feather, red cape, face and outfit. Hold one sword. Whole body and sword inside a fixed canvas. No dust, glow or camera motion.

repair.operation: Ludo built-in Fix Loop on the existing Hydra animation, once; original retained
repair.billingNote: UI showed a +0.2 credit adjustment after completion. Final exact debit and fractional starting balance were not reconciled; quote and displayed balance are recorded separately.
repair.model: Forge per Ludo official documentation; not independently confirmed from job response
repair.exportSettings: Animation Pack; individual frames; Smooth Art; common frame 418x491, common target height491, vertical offset-1. Original100%, repair93% chosen automatically by service. Both outputs exported; paths labelled hydra-original/fix-loop.

loopDiagnostic.method: Mean absolute premultiplied RGBA difference over nonempty union; wrap pair compared with internal adjacent pairs. No automatic pass/fail.
loopDiagnostic.limitations: Watermarks included. Different rendering and framing can change the values; does not establish natural motion, identity or a visually seamless loop.

repair.verdict: Loop boundary difference decreased. Walking poses and reference identity remain recognizable. Naturalness, detail drift and final loop quality require human review; no production approval.
repair.userReview: User reports that the Fix Loop result still does not connect at the end/start; not accepted as seamless.
